lines.say: In the next four minutes, you'll understand your first real Python program.
lines.tts: In the next four minutes, you'll understand your first real Python program.

lines.say: A program that prints a medicine label, like this one.
lines.tts: A program that prints a medicine label, like this one.

lines.say: And then, we'll break it on purpose, and see what Python does.
lines.tts: And then, we'll break it on purpose, and see what Python does.

lines.say: Here's the program. Five lines. Let's run it the way Python does: one line at a time, from top to bottom.
lines.tts: Here's the program. Five lines. Let's run it the way Python does: one line at a time, from top to bottom.

lines.say: Line one starts with a hash sign. That's a comment: a note for humans. Python simply skips it.
lines.tts: Line one starts with a hash sign. That's a comment: a note for humans. Python simply skips it.

lines.say: Line two: print. Print means: show this on the screen.
lines.tts: Line two: print. Print means: show this on the screen.

lines.say: The words inside the quotes are shown exactly as written. Text in quotes is called a string.
lines.tts: The words inside the quotes are shown exactly as written. Text in quotes is called a string.

lines.say: Line three prints the drug name. Every print starts on a new line.
lines.tts: Line three prints the drug name. Every print starts on a new line.

lines.say: Line four has three items, separated by commas. Python shows them one after another, with a space in between.
lines.tts: Line four has three items, separated by commas. Python shows them one after another, with a space in between.

lines.say: Line five has a small calculation. The star sign means multiply.
lines.tts: Line five has a small calculation. The star sign means multiply.

lines.say: Python first works out 500 times 3, which is 1500, and then prints the answer.
lines.tts: Python first works out five hundred times three, which is fifteen hundred, and then prints the answer.

lines.say: Four instructions, in order, from top to bottom. You've just understood your first program!
lines.tts: Four instructions, in order, from top to bottom. You've just understood your first program!

lines.say: Now, let's break it. On purpose.
lines.tts: Now, let's break it. On purpose.

lines.say: In this program, line two uses a word Python has never heard of: weight.
lines.tts: In this program, line two uses a word Python has never heard of: weight.

lines.say: Python runs line one. Then it stops at line two, and tells you exactly what went wrong.
lines.tts: Python runs line one. Then it stops at line two, and tells you exactly what went wrong.

lines.say: Name error: name weight is not defined. And line three never runs.
lines.tts: Name error: name weight is not defined. And line three never runs.

lines.say: Just like a pharmacist who stops at an unclear line on a prescription.
lines.tts: Just like a pharmacist who stops at an unclear line on a prescription.

lines.say: Now look at this one. Line two is missing its closing bracket.
lines.tts: Now look at this one. Line two is missing its closing bracket.

lines.say: This time, nothing is printed. Not even line one.
lines.tts: This time, nothing is printed. Not even line one.

lines.say: Because before running anything, Python checks that the whole program is written correctly.
lines.tts: Because before running anything, Python checks that the whole program is written correctly.

lines.say: A writing mistake like this is called a syntax error. Syntax means the grammar rules of the language.
lines.tts: A writing mistake like this is called a syntax error. Syntax means the grammar rules of the language.

lines.say: Three mistakes almost every beginner makes.
lines.tts: Three mistakes almost every beginner makes.

lines.say: One: writing Print with a capital P. Python is case-sensitive, so always use small letters.
lines.tts: One: writing Print with a capital P. Python is case-sensitive, so always use small letters.

lines.say: Two: copying code from WhatsApp, with curly quotes. Type the quotes yourself.
lines.tts: Two: copying code from WhatsApp, with curly quotes. Type the quotes yourself.

lines.say: Three: forgetting the quotes around text.
lines.tts: Three: forgetting the quotes around text.

lines.say: Remember, errors aren't failures. They're Python pointing at exactly where to look.
lines.tts: Remember, errors aren't failures. They're Python pointing at exactly where to look.

lines.say: Quick check. What does this line print?
lines.tts: Quick check. What does this line print?

lines.say: Pause and think.
lines.tts: Pause and think.

lines.say: The answer is B: Dose, 500 mg. Python did the multiplication first. Super!
lines.tts: The answer is B: Dose, five hundred milligrams. Python did the multiplication first. Super!

lines.say: Let's recap.
